doc.body:
Hi there,

With food advent calendars selling out before Thanksgiving, shoppers want thoughtful countdowns without stale cardboard packaging. 

Sunday Cookie Co. in Brooklyn is launching our Holiday Box of 12 ($34) as a real-butter 12-day holiday countdown. Packed with fresh favorites like Brown Butter Chocolate Chip and Pumpkin Spice Snickerdoodle, it offers a bakery-fresh alternative to mass-market advent boxes.

We would love to send a sample box to your desk this week for holiday gift guide consideration. Let us know where to ship your fresh batch.

Warmly,
Mai
Sunday Cookie Co.

trends.insight: National swap guides rank browned butter nutty cookies as top picks.
trends.move: Highlight browned butter foam and toasted nutty notes across all social clips.
trends.name: Holiday Swap Brown Butter Spotlight
trends.risk: Sounding like generic holiday baking rather than showcasing counter craft.
trends.what: Yahoo ranked browned butter pecan cookies first among seventeen top holiday swap recipes.
trends.why_us: Our Brown Butter Chocolate Chip cookie naturally leads this nutty holiday swap conversation.

trends.insight: Morning bakery queues form for crunchy nostalgic cereal cookie bakes.
trends.move: Run limited morning counter crunch specials and capture fresh tray pulls on video.
trends.name: Viral Cornflake Cookie Queues
trends.risk: Chasing a fleeting UK retail gimmick instead of owning our signature lineup.
trends.what: Daily Mail reported London crowds lining up before store openings for viral cornflake cookies.
trends.why_us: Our Brooklyn counter can bake morning cereal crunch batches that capture crunchy nostalgic cravings.

trends.insight: Shoppers buy holiday food advent calendars weeks early to avoid sellouts.
trends.move: Position the Holiday Box of 12 as a twelve-day holiday countdown gift.
trends.name: Food Advent Calendar Early Sellouts
trends.risk: Promising dated daily advent compartments without having specialized divider packaging ready.
trends.what: Bon Appétit tracked twenty food advent calendars already warning customers of impending sellouts.
trends.why_us: Our Holiday Box of 12 operates as an artisanal 12-day holiday countdown box.

trends.insight: Holiday hosts actively swap messy holiday pies for grab-and-go dessert boxes.
trends.move: Pitch boxed cookies as the hassle-free host offering for casual Friendsgiving gatherings.
trends.name: Friendsgiving Handheld Dessert Demand
trends.risk: Appearing to disparage traditional family holiday pie traditions on Thanksgiving Day.
trends.what: Taste of Home highlighted finger-food sweets replacing pies ahead of Friendsgiving gatherings.
trends.why_us: Boxed cookies solve subway transport headaches and eliminate pie slicing for casual hosts.

trends.insight: Press critiques of chain cookie nutrition spark appetite for clean kitchen transparency.
trends.move: Film raw counter ingredients quietly without ever making explicit nutritional or diet claims.
trends.name: Clean Label Ingredient Scrutiny
trends.risk: Violating standing brief by claiming our cookies are healthy or low-calorie.
trends.what: Daily Meal published an investigation slamming Crumbl cookie calorie density and heavy formulation.
trends.why_us: Sunday Cookie uses real butter, brown sugar and unrefined flour with zero stabilizers.

trends.insight: Shoppers explore early retail discounts on bakeware and kitchen equipment ahead of holidays.
trends.move: Monitor home kitchen enthusiasm while keeping our content focused on finished edible bakes.
trends.name: Early Black Friday Cookware Deals
trends.risk: Diluting our bakery voice by commenting on kitchen appliance sales.
trends.what: Taste of Home and The Kitchn featured early kitchenware and nonstick pan discounts.
trends.why_us: We sell baked cookies, not cookware hardware or kitchen appliances.

trends.insight: Festival gifting peaked as Diwali arrives tomorrow across US and global communities.
trends.move: Conclude Diwali gifting coverage and rotate display shelves toward upcoming holiday occasions.
trends.name: Diwali Artisan Hamper Peak
trends.risk: Promoting festival gift boxes after logistics cutoffs disappoints holiday customers.
trends.what: Press roundups highlighted luxury sweet boxes as Diwali gifting concludes this weekend.
trends.why_us: The calendar window closes within twenty-four hours, leaving no shipping runway.

trends.insight: Fast food chains launch discount promotions and freebies across national Veterans Day.
trends.move: Skip all promo discount wars and maintain our premium fixed counter pricing.
trends.name: Veterans Day Freebie Promotions
trends.risk: Violating our core brand rule against discounting and cheapening premium small-batch positioning.
trends.what: Dozens of national restaurant chains announced free meals and discounts for Veterans Day.
trends.why_us: Our standing brief strictly forbids discount offers and promo giveaways across channels.

trends.insight: Chains push raw dough bowls, but social media backlash questions digestion.
trends.move: Pass on raw dough trends and double down on oven-baked golden rims.
trends.name: Scoopable Cookie Dough Tubs
trends.risk: Jumping on unbaked novelty gimmicks erodes our freshly baked counter identity.
trends.what: Crumbl launched scoopable dough tubs, drawing mixed reviews over excessive sweetness and heaviness.
trends.why_us: We are an artisanal Brooklyn bakery committed to warm, freshly baked cookies.
